regime.detail: Stocks are falling while Treasury yields fall, so money is moving into bonds.
flags: gold is falling too, so even a usual safe haven is being sold

read: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% on Friday, Nov 20 and fell 8.6% over the past week. The VIX closed at 35.9.
Over the week, the 10-year yield fell 24 bp to 4.91%, oil fell 5.2%, gold fell 9.5%, the dollar rose 0.4%, and chip stocks fell 17.8%.
Strongest sector this week: Consumer staples (−2.0%). Weakest: Semiconductors (−17.8%).
The biggest news themes right now: Geopolitics & war, AI & chips, Trade, tariffs & China.
